description: This PHP source file defines the EntityRevision class, a Drupal plugin for migrating entity revisions, including methods for retrieving, saving, and managing revision entities within the migration process.

classes.name: EntityRevision
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for migrating entity revisions, handling revision retrieval, creation, and ID management during migration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EntityRevision plugin with configuration, migration, storage, and related services.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an entity revision based on row data and old destination IDs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entity revision and returns its revision ID.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the IDs used for the revision, including revision and language codes if applicable.

methods.name: getHighestId
methods.description: Retrieves the highest revision ID for the entity type.
